sources.observed_facts: Full local specification and linked task checklist read; scope evaluated individually. Archive/checkmarks are selection evidence only.

Read embed directive parsing, filesystem collection and no-declaration fallback; collectManifestResources keeps full manifest paths without a YAML extension restriction, and missing metadata is not required.
Actual serializer appends manifest, frontend, SQL/i18n and full manifest-resource sections using shared protocol names.
Standard command defaults out to repository temp/output and passes explicit resolved output directory to WriteRuntimeWasmArtifactFromSource.
Final output and intermediate runtime path honor explicit directories; repository detection defaults into temp/output internal workspace rather than plugin source.
Actual buildGuestRuntimeWasm resolves intermediate output via resolveGuestRuntimeOutputPath before compilation.
Inspected custom-section parser that validates and decodes manifest resources into runtime artifacts.
buildArtifactDefaultConfig selects manifest/config/config.yaml, excludes template as runtime default; buildArtifactManifestResources exposes original resource bytes relative to manifest/.
Manifest host service scopes artifact resources to plugin and calls reader Get/GetMany/List, validating requested resource path.
Inspected assertions for declared embedded sections, fallback preservation of config/metadata/SQL/i18n/non-YAML paths, default output location and explicit/relative final plus intermediate paths.
